services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Four dedicated divisions, one promise: the right part, at the right time.

s1.name: Original Spare Parts
s1.short: 100% genuine OEM parts supplied to dealerships, workshops and individuals.
s1.long1: We partner with authorized distributors to supply original OEM spare parts for passenger cars and light commercial vehicles.
s1.long2: Every part passes a verification stage against the manufacturer catalog before it is packed, so you always receive the exact reference you ordered.
steps: Send the OEM number or part name
Pickup from the store or same-day delivery

s2.name: Used & Recycled Parts
s2.short: Carefully inspected used parts with a professional grading system.
s2.long1: Our salvage team inspects every used part and grades it (A / B / C) so you know exactly what you are buying.
s2.long2: High-turnover items such as engines, gearboxes and body panels are pressure-tested and photo-documented before shipping.
steps: Sourcing the part from our stock network
Full inspection and A / B / C grading

s3.name: Order-by-Order Import
s3.short: We source rare and discontinued parts from global markets within days.
s3.long1: Cannot find a part locally? Send us the OEM number and we source it directly from trusted suppliers in Asia, Europe and the Gulf.
s3.long2: You receive a fixed quote with customs and shipping included before we place the order — no surprises.
steps: Send the OEM number via WhatsApp or the form
Fixed quote including customs and shipping

s4.name: Delivery & Shipping
s4.short: Same-day delivery inside the city and nationwide shipping with live tracking.
s4.long1: Orders confirmed before 2:00 PM are delivered the same day across the city, with nationwide shipping following a daily schedule.
s4.long2: Every shipment is tracked and insured, and our hotline stays open for delivery follow-up from 9 AM to 9 PM.

hero.desc: Honda Prince is a specialized trading company in automotive spare parts — serving workshops, dealerships and private customers with genuine parts, fair prices and fast delivery.

about.p1: Honda Prince started as a small spare parts shop with a simple belief: no customer should wait weeks for a missing part. Today we are a full trading company distributing genuine parts across the country.
about.p2: We combine deep technical knowledge with a strict supply chain, which is why workshops and dealerships trust us with their daily operations.
about.p3: Our team verifies every reference, grades every used part, and stands behind every delivery.

vision.p1: We look at the country's roads and see more than cars — we see businesses that depend on them. Trucks that feed markets, taxis that move cities, families that travel safely.
vision.p2: Our vision is simple: build the most reliable spare parts supply network in the region, so that no vehicle stays parked longer than it should.
vision.p3: Every part we stock, every supplier we work with, and every person we hire is a step toward that future.
